acceptance_gate: A proves the transmission rule, the one-sided theorem, growth and the regime map with exhaustive checks on all three- and four-variable knots and all laws generated by one relation on at most three bits; B proves loops, memory, transparency, hardness and infinite-cycle statements with checks.
objective: The owner asked to continue from the pairs-versus-triples boundary of the protected thesis, to treat it as the base level, to challenge workspace assumptions where that gives a more interesting result, and to try to intuit the underlying theory, including cycles that act everywhere. The plan was a base-level map over every law on bits: knots, extension, composition, transparency. Scoping refuted the first prediction (knots and extension coincide): of the 34 three-variable knots, exactly two (not all on, not all off) force values in one direction only and never compose, while the other 32 force both values, compose into one knot on all their other distinctions exactly when they force a shared distinction oppositely (10,404 of 10,404 placements), and grow by one per atom along chains. So the base has three regimes: pairs (no knots), frozen triples (one-signed knots), transmitting triples. A proves the transmission rule, the one-sided theorem, growth and the regime map, checked on every law generated by one relation on three bits. B proves what the regimes carry: pairwise cycles as loops, lasting ring memory exactly when every polymorphism is affine, the matching failure of local reasoning, hardness only inside transmission, and the two ways a cycle can act everywhere.
status: Complete 2026-10-21. Every law on bits is pairwise (no knots; pairwise cycles are loops), frozen (only 'not all on' or 'not all off' knots, which never compose) or transmitting (knots compose exactly when they force a shared distinction oppositely, and chains grow by one per atom); the prediction that knots and extension coincide was refuted. A law keeps a lasting record of loops exactly when it defines parity, exactly when its polymorphisms are affine, exactly when (with constants) no bounded local reasoning decides it; hardness lies inside transmission with memory, and memory with any irreversible relation is search. Census of the 273 laws generated by one relation on at most three bits: 183 pairwise, 2 frozen, 32 forcing, 2 conservation, 54 choice. The two-versus-three boundary is exact because distinctions are bits; on three values pairs can knot. Next (owner's choice): three-valued distinctions (2/3), dynamics, or banking.
stop_rule: One bounded epic. If the regime map fails on some law, record the counterexample and the corrected map; do not extend to larger domains in this epic.
title: What appears at three? The base map of laws on distinctions
